blocks.text: Electronic waste (e-waste) is created when devices are discarded or replaced. Improper disposal of e-waste can harm the environment and human health. Sustainable computing includes recycling, reusing, and reducing electronic devices responsibly. Energy-efficient devices and environmentally friendly practices reduce the negative impact of technology. Proper e-waste management ensures resources are preserved and pollution is minimized.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Recycling, reusing, and energy-efficient devices reduce environmental harm.
